business_problem: Trinity ViaggiStudio needed to answer growing volumes of real-time questions from students, parents, companions, universities, and partner colleges, but manual service across messaging channels could not keep pace or support higher website conversion.
solution_summary: Trinity ViaggiStudio worked with IBM Business Partner Ubico to build Trinny, a 24x7 website assistant based on IBM watsonx Assistant. The implementation centered on a live-chat widget for site visitors and a knowledge layer built from Trinity's FAQs and service responses, including content that initially came from an Excel-based source and was then expanded through gradual uploads. Watsonx Assistant provides the natural-language understanding and response engine, while the operating process around it continuously monitors conversations to identify new intents or gaps in the knowledge base. The assistant now handles more than 120 trained question types, answers most routine website inquiries autonomously, and directs prospects to relevant catalog downloads, contact forms, and appointment-booking pages. The design gives Trinity one conversational front end for support and lead generation, while its roadmap extends that experience toward CRM integration and guided study-program selection.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Powers Trinny's natural-language understanding and automated response flow for website visitors.

data_flow: Questions from website visitors enter the Trinny chat widget, watsonx Assistant matches them against the uploaded FAQ and customer-service content, answers routine queries, and routes interested prospects to catalog, contact, or appointment pages while conversation feedback is used to improve future responses.
business_outcome: Trinity created always-on self-service, reduced customer-service workload, captured qualified leads from conversations, and improved the speed and quality of responses for prospective travelers and their families.
metrics: about 85% of the overall questions asked by website visitors
architecture_clues: The initial knowledge base could be bootstrapped from an Excel file and then expanded with additional FAQ uploads.
The team continuously monitors conversations to identify missing intents and improve bot training.
Trinity plans to connect the assistant with company software and CRM for guided experience selection.
